note: USACE Perry Lake campground near the north end, 1.5 mi east of Ozawkie off KS-92, on a low point with the lake on two sides (flood-prone; recreation.gov said in Nov 2026 that flood damage had left the park partly closed, though every site was bookable). The electric loops A and E are shaded and set back from the shore; the six non-electric B sites are on open grass. Water is shut off outside the peak season (vault toilets stay open). --Claude
